tier_note: tier 1 = 一级字 (1–3500, 常用字), 2 = 二级字 (3501–6500), 3 = 三级字 (6501–8105); index = official 字序
level_note: level = lowest HSK 3.0 level (1–7, 7 = HSK 7–9) of any data/hsk_words.json word containing the character; null if none
pinyin_note: pinyin = pypinyin default (most common) reading, unless it is not among the table readings — then the first toned table reading (plus override 卜 bǔ); readings = all readings listed in the jaywcjlove/togscc dataset (which took them from zh.wiktionary Appendix:通用规范汉字表)
